title: Vectors: RFC 8613 test vectors
close_reason: Umbrella bead satisfied by test/vectors/oscore.json as a whole: RFC 8613 key derivation (C.1-C.3), request protection (C.4-C.6), response protection (C.7-C.8), roundtrip protect/unprotect, replay-window accept/reject/window-edge/large-jump, PIV boundary encodings 0..2^40-1 with nonce-XOR construction and piv_overflow rejection, invalid-input rejections, and SSN-restore-after-NVM-failure vectors with independently verifiable nonces. Machine-consumed by python/tests/crypto/test_oscore_vectors.py (all families) and rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs.
